title: Routine Authentication of Drosophila using RFLP Markers
author: Lauren McCann
materials: When finished with all samples, run the following thermocycler protocol as follows: 37°C for 30 minutes 95°C for 2 minutes Volume 50 µL

When thermocycler is finished, samples can be placed in -20°C freezer or continue to next stage. Preps are often good for a year (or longer) if amplifying small DNA fragments, though repeated freeze/ thaw will shorten its lifespan.
Briefly vortex your master mix until homogeneous

steps.title: Collect and Prepare Fly Samples
steps.instruction: Collect female flies from stocks of interest and prepare them for DNA extraction.

substeps.instruction: Prepare and label tubes for stocks of interest (e.g., DMEL_42, DMEL_57, DMEL_217, DMEL_357, DMEL_391, DMEL_399, DMEL_437, DMEL_491, DMEL_508, DMEL_810, MV2-25, TreeLine, Flagstaff14, Flagstaff16).
Anesthetize flies with CO2.
Sort 2 females per stock variant, placing 1 fly per tube into the pre-labeled tubes.
Place flies in a -20°C freezer one day prior to DNA extraction.

steps.title: Extract DNA from Flies
steps.instruction: Extract DNA using a squishing buffer and Proteinase-K.

substeps.instruction: Create a fresh master mix for a 50µL reaction (amplified by 1 + number of samples) by combining 49.5 µL Squishing Buffer and 0.5 µL Proteinase-K Solution.
Draw up 50 µL of master mix and stab one fly repeatedly with the pipette tip, slowly releasing the solution to moisten the fly so it sticks to the tube.
Mash the fly for approximately 20 seconds until the liquid turns red, then eject any remaining master mix into the tube over the carcass.
Replace the pipette tip and repeat for all samples; keep preps on ice until finished.

steps.title: Prepare PCR Master Mixes
steps.instruction: Prepare marker-specific master mixes for the PCR reactions.

substeps.instruction: Prepare master mixes for each marker for a single 12.75 µL reaction (amplified by 1 + number of samples for a negative control) containing: 6.5 µL Promega GoTaqGreen, 0.5 µL Upstream primer (10µM), 0.5 µL Downstream primer (10µM), and 5.25 µL Nuclease-free water.

steps.title: Set Up and Run PCR
steps.instruction: Distribute master mix and DNA samples into a 96-well plate and perform touchdown PCR.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 11.75 µL of the appropriate master mix into wells as assigned (DPSE: 2 markers, DMEL: 4 markers).
Add 1 µL of DNA sample into the appropriate wells (2 samples per stock: 1 DPSE sample allocated to 2 wells, 1 DMEL sample allocated to 4 wells).

Seal the well plate and run the touchdown PCR protocol: 2 min at 95°C; 10 cycles of (30 sec 95°C, 30 sec 65°C decreasing by 1°C/cycle, 30 sec 72°C); 20 cycles of (30 sec 95°C, 30 sec 55°C, 30 sec 72°C); 2 min at 72°C; hold at 4°C.
Store samples at -20°C or proceed to the next stage.

steps.title: Perform Restriction Digest
steps.instruction: Digest the PCR products using EcoR1/SspI enzymes.

substeps.instruction: In a new 96-well plate, add the following reagents to each well in the specified order: 3.4µL Nuclease-free water, 1µL 10X NEBuffer EcoR1/SspI, 5µL DNA sample, and 0.5µL EcoR1 enzyme.
Seal the plate and run the thermocycler program for ECOR1: 60 min at 37°C (Volume 10 µL).
Add 2µL of purple loading dye to each well to stop the reaction.
Store samples at -20°C or proceed to electrophoresis.

steps.title: Prepare Agarose Gel
steps.instruction: Cast an agarose gel containing Ethidium Bromide.

substeps.instruction: Measure 2g of agarose and add to an Erlenmeyer flask with 100mL of 1x TAE buffer.
Microwave in 30-second increments, swirling until the solution is clear and powder is dissolved.
Allow the mixture to cool until warm to the touch but not burning.
Add 5µL of EtBr to the flask and swirl.
Pour the gel into the tray with the well comb in place and let it solidify.

steps.title: Run Gel Electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Load the digested DNA samples and run the gel to analyze results.

substeps.instruction: Turn on the machine, place the gel in the tray, close the door, and select Nucleic Acid dye: Ethidium bromide.
Remove the tray and place the gel in the electrophoresis unit with wells on the black side (DNA runs toward the red side).
Add 1x TAE buffer to cover the gel in the box.
Add 5µL of ladder into the first well and 5µL of each DNA sample into corresponding wells, ensuring the tip does not stab the gel.
Place the cover on, attach the power source, and set to 100v for 30 min.
Verify the run by the appearance of small bubbles.
Take photos of the gel, edit as needed to view bands, and compare results to the guide.
